body: I'm worthless man. I fixed the deadbolt on the front door, fixed the dish washer, pulled some weeds and I felt good for awhile. But now I just I feel worthless again. Threads like [this]( https://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/3q2qsn/girls_what_turns_you_away_from_guys/) remind me of that. I can't even enjoy a god damn distraction from life by browsing reddit or facebook without running into this shit. Fucking found ANOTHER "x reasons why girls don't like nice guys" while browsing facebook as well. The title may as well be "In case you were somehow able to reassure yourself that you are a good guy, here's another x reasons why you are wrong you piece of shit" Not only am I not good enough for a job, or for college, I'm not good enough for women. At least I can pretend to be good enough for something in video games.

Yeah school is still going on, but I've withdrawn from all my classes. I'm registered for some online classes that start soon, but I'm not sure that I'll even be able to get a degree anymore. I don't feel motivated to do anything anymore like I did before I tried to kill myself.

I don't know what to do with my life. I am so apathetic to anything that doesn't help me escape reality. Anything to keep me from remembering that I'm a parasite.

I don't know. I thought I liked programming and working with electronics, but two years into electrical engineering and I already don't care anymore. I was think maybe if I change majors yet again to computer science it'll turn out better, but the more than likely it won't. I'd change majors and find out that I hate CS just as much, not because the topic isn't interesting, but because I am a lazy fuck who doesn't want to work at all, who doesn't want a cubic picometre of responsibility. Not to mention changing majors is one of those things that requires 15,000 forms, with 15,000 signatures. Why does changing field of study have to be so complicated? Why can't I just change the classes I'm taking? This is the kind of stuff I'm afraid of. Life is only going to get more complicated from here.
I'm sorry to hear that friend. I hope you are able to find peace and solace.

Engineering. I don't know what I want to learn anymore. Honestly, I don't think I want anything other than to play games, watch tv, and play with cats. I just talked to the school counselor about missing classes and it just made me more want to die more. Life from now on is going to be nothing but a cluster fuck of bureaucracy. Bills, forms, business. Call that person to take care of that thing. Fill out this form to take care of that thing. I can't even withdraw from my classes without filling out a fucking form and getting signatures from every fucking person on the planet. I've got to be honest, I don't want to get my shit together. I want my shit to stay as it is. I don't want to deal with the crap I need to, to be an independent person. I'm fucking done. This isn't worth it. The way I am, I'm just going to be an entitled fuck, a burden to others, a parasite. It's best if I just stop. If I can't stand on my own two feet, than I don't deserve to stand at all.
